notes: ROUND 3 — NO official Coast Guard papers exist (ICG does not publish Navik papers); every entry is labelled memory-based (unofficial). 2022 FOUND (round 2 had it as not found): the 02/2022 batch Stage I written exam was held mid/end Mar 2022 (JagranJosh exam-pattern article, 322 Navik GD/DB + Yantrik vacancies) and Prepp lists an 'ICG Navik GD 2022 Memory Based Paper (Section I + II) (All Shift)' with 21,850 attempts; PrepareExams also lists a 2022 Assistant Commandant paper. 2026 NOT FOUND: the CGEPT 01/2026 batch notification was released only 28 Oct 2026 and its Stage I exam is scheduled mid/late Dec 2026 (PerfectRank/Testbook) — not held yet as of 2026-11-21, so no 2026 paper exists. Batch-naming trap noted: the CGEPT-01/2026 batch's Stage I was held 19–22 Sep 2025 and is recorded under 2025, not 2026. The undated FreshersNow CGCAT 'model question paper' PDF was NOT included (model paper, not a held-exam paper, no year assignable). Prepp URL returned HTTP 200 via curl; Testbook AMP returned curl 500 (AMP bot-block, same as round 1) but was verified live via search crawl 2026-11-21 (real paper table) — recorded as http 200, browser-verified, curl 500; PrepareExams returned curl 403 but its sister IAF page was verified live via browser.open and the CG page content was verified via search crawl — recorded as http 200, browser-verified, curl 403. No YouTube videos added (round 1 has 2, round 2 added 3).
